evals.name: start-picks-maps
evals.setup: A checked session is open in `ROOT/session/`; no `ROOT/cascade/` exists. `gomake --list` shows the `:cascade:*` targets. `gomake :cascade:roots` prints one root, `github.com/ctx42/testing`, with uncommitted changes. `modmap.yaml` holds two maps: `ctx42`, where six modules depend on `github.com/ctx42/testing` over three rounds, and `gitaid`, with two dependents. Every repository is on `master`, clean and in sync with origin, except dependent `github.com/ctx42/xftp`, which is 1 commit behind `origin/master`. Asked which maps to release, the user picks `ctx42` only.

evals.name: test-failure-fix-or-stop
evals.setup: An active migration in phase 1; `ROOT/cascade/run.log` already has `test` lines from an earlier run, in which `github.com/ctx42/ring` passed. The preflight passes. A `go.work` in the parent directory lists every module. Dependent `github.com/ctx42/xrr` fails to compile: it calls `testing.Must`, which the changed module renamed to `testing.MustOK`. The user accepts the proposed rename.

evals.name: gate-needs-explicit-yes
evals.setup: An active migration in phase 1 in which every module has just passed its tests. Asked for the go-ahead to release, the user replies: "yes, but leave github.com/ctx42/xftp out for now."

evals.name: release-stops-without-rollback
evals.setup: An active migration in phase 2. `gomake :cascade:progress` names `github.com/ctx42/xrr` next; the changed module is already released. Plan order after it: xrr (marked `in-place`), `github.com/ctx42/xftp` (marked `skip`), `github.com/ctx42/ring`. `gomake :cascade:env` prints `GOWORK=off` and `GOFLAGS=-mod=mod`. The user asks to also release the unpicked `gitaid` map. ring's `gomake :bump -u` fails.

evals.name: resume-never-replans
evals.setup: An active migration in phase 1; `run.log` holds `start`, `pick`, `preflight`, and `mark` lines and no `test` line. Since the start, `modmap.yaml` gained `github.com/ctx42/xcfg`, a new dependent of the changed module.
evals.query: /cascade — and make sure the new module is included
